name: Shishak
bio: Shishak was king of Egypt. When Solomon sought to kill his official Jeroboam after the prophet Ahijah announced that Jeroboam would receive ten tribes of the kingdom, Jeroboam fled to Shishak's Egypt and remained there in exile until Solomon's death (1 Kings 11:40). Shishak's later invasion of Judah, during the reign of Solomon's son Rehoboam, is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
